issue.problem: Foul-smelling, brownish water discharge from a water cooler
issue.location: Second floor of the science block
issue.severity_reason: Contaminated drinking water poses a significant impact on health and sanitation for building occupants.
user_reported_facts: The water cooler has a foul smell.
The water cooler has a brownish discharge.
The issue has persisted for the last two days.
The water cooler is located on the second floor of the science block.
inferred_information: The water supply or internal filtration system of the water cooler is contaminated (uncertain technical conclusion).
missing_information: Visual confirmation of the water condition
Exact make and model of the water cooler
issue.recommended_action: Immediately disable the water cooler to prevent consumption, place an 'Out of Order' sign, and dispatch a plumbing or water quality maintenance team to inspect and sanitize the unit.
